description:
PR: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/pull/847

Objective
Reduce test/support boilerplate while preserving every test, property, assertion, scenario input and execution boundary. Complete PR inventory: 115 files, 13,303 additions, including 9,066 test/support additions.

Implemented; awaiting review
- Share connector constructors across saved connections, restart/storage, credential fixtures, enable/disable Actions, full flow, thread history and People tests.
- Share synthetic runtime configuration, bound profiles and State child specs.
- Centralize serial-test application environment restoration, including absent keys.
- Share exact credential-document request construction and local lifecycle delivery wrappers.
- Move repeated lifecycle State initialization to module-local setup and shorten disable Action invocation.
- Adapter delegate extraction was evaluated and retained explicitly because extra abstraction did not provide worthwhile savings. A UI-result wrapper trial increased formatted line count and was discarded.

Measured result
193 fewer lines net across 17 test/support files relative to PR HEAD: 344 removed, 151 added, including both new support modules. This is 135 additional lines beyond the initial 58-line cleanup. No production changes. Larger reductions have not been substantiated.

Preservation and validation
- All 1,125 registered test/property names across the PR's 52 changed test files match the baseline.
- All 4,861 assertion expressions preserved, normalizing only the mechanically extracted Action, credential-document and lifecycle delivery calls.
- Affected isolated suites: 132 tests + 7 properties, 0 failures.
- Broader precommit run: 142 tests + 7 properties, 0 failures.
- After removing unused aliases, the adjusted suites and final precommit each passed 32 tests + 1 property.
- Final mix q and mix precommit passed. Existing test/repro filename-filter warning remains.
- No tests deleted, skipped or weakened; concurrency sequencing, authorization inputs, cleanup and runtime ownership remain intact.
- No commit or push. Keep in progress pending human review.

Action reuse assessment
Not applicable: only test scaffolding changed. Existing product Actions, NodeRouter and public execution paths are preserved. Reused test support only where construction and configuration semantics match.

Applicable policies: docs/testing-approach.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md. Any future behavioral expectation change requires explicit human approval.

comments.text: Implemented shared WhatsApp connector/configuration fixtures, module-local lifecycle setup, and a local disable Action invocation helper. Existing CommunicationFixtures reuses rows and inserts different defaults, so it cannot preserve these connector scenarios; the new fixture retains the original changeset/insert path. Adapter delegation extraction evaluated and left explicit: two callers do not justify macro scaffolding for minimal savings. Action reuse remains not applicable (test-only). Registered inventory unchanged: 72 tests/properties. Isolated suite: 71 tests + 1 property, 0 failures. mix q passed. Final diff audit and mix precommit in progress.

Implementation and validation complete; awaiting human review, changes remain uncommitted. Five connector builders now reuse Zaq.WhatsAppFixtures with the original inputs; three serial tests share configuration restoration; lifecycle initialization is module-local setup; disable Action calls use a local wrapper. Net reduction: 58 lines (121 removed, 63 added including the 31-line support module). Registered test/property names match the baseline exactly (72). AST audit preserves all 492 assertion expressions, normalizing only the extracted Jido.Exec invocation wrapper. Final isolated run: 71 tests + 1 property, 0 failures. Final mix q passed. Final mix precommit passed, exit 0 (10 stale tests + 1 property, 0 failures); non-failing warnings concern unavailable license_manager config and existing test/repro filename filters. Initial precommit tool call hit its 300-second transport timeout; its orphaned process was stopped and final validation rerun with a captured log and 900-second execution bound. Log: /tmp/zaq-5f9-precommit.log. No production changes; E2E and new property tests not applicable to behavior-preserving test scaffolding.

User rejected the 58-line result as insufficient for the PR-size objective. Correction: gh pr view files returned only the first 100 of 115 files. Full paginated inventory shows 9,066 test/support additions (68.1% of 13,303), not 6,680. Previously omitted major suites include node_router_coordination_test.exs (592), channels_live_test.exs (+470), whatsapp_thread_history_test.exs (358), and linked_device_ui_test.exs (258). The completed edits are minor cleanup, not completion of the broader size objective. Reassessment found that major suites already use generated cases, helper functions, and distinct lifecycle/security/concurrency scenarios; no substantiated thousand-line deduplication has been identified. Potential prerequisite PR boundaries: coordination files ~1,050 additions and credential-document files ~910 additions, subject to dependency analysis; splitting would reduce individual PR size, not total code. No further code edits made during this reassessment. Keep issue in progress.

Continuing implementation under renewed user instruction. Broaden the same behavior-preserving scaffolding refactor across the complete paginated PR test inventory: shared synthetic runtime bindings/state specs, credential-document request builders, serial configuration restoration, repeated UI result delivery, and existing connector fixtures. Preserve registered test/property names and every assertion through direct comparison after expanding thin helper calls. Keep concurrency sequencing, deadlines, authorization inputs, and production code unchanged. Action reuse remains not applicable; only test support is affected. Reject extraction if it obscures scenario inputs or adds more scaffolding than it removes.

Broader implementation now removes 191 net lines relative to PR HEAD (341 removed, 150 added including both new support modules). Added shared synthetic runtime config/profile/state-spec builders, reused the connector fixture in credential fixtures, enable/disable, thread-history and People suites, extracted exact credential-document request construction and private lifecycle delivery, and centralized serial-test environment restoration. A trial UI result wrapper increased formatted line count and was discarded. Full PR inventory comparison: all 1,125 test/property names preserved across 52 changed test files. AST comparison: all 4,861 assertion expressions preserved, normalizing only the thin extracted Action, credential-document and lifecycle-delivery calls. mix q passed; affected run of 14 suites passed (132 tests + 7 properties, 0 failures). Final precommit running. No production edits, no commit/push. Action reuse remains not applicable; original product execution boundaries are retained.

Final continuation result: 193 net lines removed from PR HEAD, including all new helper code (343 removed, 150 added). This is 135 additional lines beyond the original 58-line cleanup. Scope is 17 test/support files; production code is unchanged. Full PR baseline: 1,125 registered tests/properties preserved; all 4,861 assertion expressions across 52 changed test files preserved with only extracted-call normalization. Isolated affected suites: 132 tests + 7 properties passed. Broader precommit pass also ran 142 tests + 7 properties successfully. Removed 3 unused aliases reported during that pass; their 32 tests + 1 property passed again. Final mix q and final mix precommit both passed on the completed changes (final stale run: 32 tests + 1 property, 0 failures). Remaining warning is the existing test/repro filename-filter warning. No tests deleted/skipped/weakened, no commit/push, no split PRs. Issue remains in progress awaiting review; 193 lines is a measured scaffolding reduction and does not imply the 13k-line feature can be compressed by thousands without scope or coverage changes.

title: [#847] Reduce test boilerplate while preserving every test and assertion
